title: CI green: gofmt/terrafmt/golangci-lint violations fixed
essence: All GitHub Actions CI workflows (golint.yml, terrafmt.yml, unit-test.yml) were failing on main due to accumulated formatting drift and lint violations. This initiative fixes every violation — gofmt, terrafmt, and golangci-lint — so CI passes on every PR to main going forward.
